name: Satisfyer Curvy Trinity 4
summary: Clever 3-in-1 budget powerhouse combining Satisfyer's Air-Pulse wave nozzle, classic vibration tip, and ergonomic thumb grip under $50.
ranking_rationale: Delivers genuine contactless air-pulse suction PLUS pinpoint tip rumble in one compact shape; weighed against air-pulse buzzes noticeably louder on top settings than womanizer smart silence.

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Delivers genuine contactless air-pulse suction PLUS pinpoint tip rumble in one compact shape
Deep waterproof build at impulse budget price (~$40)
cons: Air-pulse buzzes noticeably louder on top settings than Womanizer Smart Silence
Firm nozzle lip shape fits differently than LELO Sona
